description: This file contains implementation of snapshot matching and screenshot comparison utilities for Playwright testing framework, including classes and functions for handling snapshot files, comparing images, and generating test results.

classes.name: SnapshotHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing snapshot and screenshot comparison, including file paths, comparison logic, and result generation.

methods.name: toMatchSnapshot
methods.description: Function to compare a received buffer or string against a stored snapshot, with support for updating snapshots.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshot
methods.description: Async function to compare a page or locator screenshot against a stored expected image, with options for updating or regenerating snapshots.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshotStepTitle
methods.description: Generates a step title string for screenshot-related test steps.
